method: Changed-boundary review of ping-a1 (rule: button 3 held, cut through release + 2 s). 47 segments are byte-equal JSON objects to segments-evidence.v3 (7bfa7d53, pinned by v2) and every v2 frame in them re-hashes equal: v2 verdicts reused. The 5 seg-030 children were judged on native frames: 186 new frames decoded with the same exact-PTS decoder (showinfo proof), BelowNormal, 4 threads, streamed, obs64/Marvel absent and free RAM >= 2 GiB before every window; every frame of the last 0.4 s of seg-030-a1-00 and first 0.25 s of seg-030-a1-04 plus 6-frame spacing through 2 s. All 150 owner review frames hash equal (own_hud flags equal). Every mouse button, wheel event and key inside the two new accepts replayed from inputs.jsonl. Guard change checked: the snapshot's scan.py differs only in decoder threads (4 to 2) and vote-frame disk spooling; read_sample is unchanged.
findings: Lesson applied: the v2 record (49842f90) wrongly accepted old seg-030, which contained a ping wheel at 365.827 s; this record supersedes it.
